description: Split a restaurant bill and compute the tip per person with one-tap tip percentages or a custom rate.

faqs.a: The tip is calculated on the pre-tax bill amount you enter, then added to it. Tax handling varies by country, so this tool keeps it simple: one bill total, one tip.
faqs.q: Is the tip calculated on the bill before or after tax?

faqs.a: Yes — the per-person share divides the bill plus tip equally among everyone at the table.
faqs.q: Can I split the bill evenly between everyone?

faqs.a: No, everything is computed in your browser. The bill amount never leaves your device.
faqs.q: Is my bill amount sent anywhere?

howto: Tap a quick tip percentage or type your own.
Enter the number of people splitting the bill.
Read the tip amount, total and each person's share.
title: Tip Calculator
